critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/georisques.py: normalised aggregation over 5 public endpoints (rapport, rga, radon, catnat, ICPE) with 3-attempt retry + 20 s per-call timeout; ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=5) parallelises the fetch and asyncio.to_thread runs it off the event loop. 30-day cache in `risks` collection keyed by property id; when a fresh partial refresh occurs and a better cached snapshot exists, the cache is preserved (line 191-192). to_json drops mongo _id and ISO-formats fetched_at.

/app/backend/dossier.py:64-94: dossier_flags drive ERP reason ('Toujours requis · ' + summary_lines) and force geotechnique to required=true when argile.code ∈ {2,3} AND property_type=='maison' — matches the review requirement.
/app/backend/server.py:648-658: GET /properties/{pid}/risks is protected by auth.own() (401 sans token, 404 for unowned/missing id), returns 502 with truncated error if fetch throws — safe fallback.

/app/frontend/src/components/RisksCard.tsx: uses @tanstack/react-query with staleTime 1 h and manual refetch on error; testIDs match spec (risks-card, risks-summary, risks-argile/radon/catnat/icpe, risk-{key}, risks-toggle, risks-flag-geotech, risks-source). Toggle threshold hard-coded to 4 which matches spec ('les N autres risques').
/app/frontend/app/property/[id]/dossier.tsx:116-121: dossier-risks-note appears only when d.risks truthy and mentions the argile flag when geotechnique_required — good defensive rendering.
